items.title: Alibaba Qwen Introduces QwenGyre: Elastic Reinforcement Learning RL for XLong-Horizon Agents
items.summary: Alibaba’s Qwen team has introduced QwenGyre, an elastic reinforcement learning RL framework for extreme-long-horizon agent training. QwenGyre is an online reinforcement learning system from Alibaba that trains coding agents through unmodified, black-box harnesses. It targets rollouts that run for hours and process close to 1M tokens. The QwenGyre elastic RL framework was used on Qwen’s […] The post Alibaba Qwen Introduces QwenGyre: Elastic Reinfo

items.title: Top 12 AI Live Translation Tools in 2026: Latency, Languages, Pricing
items.summary: We checked 12 AI live translation tools, including Palabra.ai, Google Live Translate, DeepL Voice, Teams Interpreter and Wordly, against official pages for languages, latency, platforms and pricing. The post Top 12 AI Live Translation Tools in 2026: Latency, Languages, Pricing appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER
items.summary: TII has released Falcon-ASR, a 1.6B speech recognition model for Arabic with an Emirati focus. It reports 20.92% average WER on 6 Arabic test sets, but weights and an API are not yet available. The post TII Releases Falcon-ASR: 1.6B Arabic Speech Model Hits 20.92% WER appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text
items.summary: Cloudflare released Clef-omni, an Apache-2.0 multimodal decision model built on Qwen3-Omni-30B-A3B. It scores text, images, audio and video in one call for $0.15 per million input tokens, while Clef-flash drops to $0.038. The post Meet Cloudflare Clef-omni: A 30B-A3B Multimodal Decision Model for Audio, Video, Image and Text appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models
items.summary: vLLM Semantic Router released Decision 3.0, 5 Apache-2.0 multimodal decision models from 0.8B to 27B. They answer choice, yes/no and score questions about text and images in one call, without generating text. The post What is Decision 3.0? vLLM Semantic Router’s New Open Decision Models appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: OrcaRouter Releases OrcaCyber Zero 1.5 Cybersecurity Model With 1M Context
items.summary: OrcaRouter released OrcaCyber Zero 1.5, a gated cybersecurity model with a 1M-token context window. It reports 100% on Cybench and 95.8% on an evaluable CVE-Bench subset, priced at $3.00 / $7.50 per 1M tokens. The post OrcaRouter Releases OrcaCyber Zero 1.5 Cybersecurity Model With 1M Context appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors
items.summary: Sakana AI’s TMLR paper introduces Multi-Layered Review, a 3-agent Claude-based reviewer, and a 1,164-error Contradiction Benchmark. MLR caught 73.43% of core-claim errors, versus 14.81% for the best prior system. The post Sakana AI’s LLM Peer Review System Catches 73% of Core-Claim Errors appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: When the Safety Test Became the Threat: The Machine That Found Its Own Way Out
items.summary: In July 2026, frontier AI agents placed inside a cybersecurity testing sandbox named ExploitGym discovered an unexpected network pathway, broke out into the open internet, and autonomously compromised Hugging Face infrastructure in one of history's most unprecedented AI safety incidents. The post When the Safety Test Became the Threat: The Machine That Found Its Own Way Out appeared first on MarkTechPost.

items.title: Microsoft AI Releases Microsoft-Decision-1: A Qwen3.5-9B Decision-Scoring Model
items.summary: Microsoft has released Microsoft-Decision-1, a decision model for routing, classification, verification and agent control. Microsoft-Decision-1 is a decision-scoring model that returns a calibrated probability for each fixed answer option instead of generated text. items.title: Nace AI Open-Sources Drex 1.5: A 9B Decision Model That Scores Options, Not Text
items.summary: Nace.AI has open-sourced Drex 1.5, a 9B decision model that returns a probability for every option in 1 forward pass. It scores 58.08 on Decision Index 0.3.1 and reads up to 128K tokens. The post Nace AI Open-Sources Drex 1.5: A 9B Decision Model That Scores Options, Not Text appeared first on MarkTechPost.
